Iron Cross: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides.
Raise one arm straight out to the side and the other straight out in front, both to shoulder height.
Lower with control and alternate which arm goes forward. Keep the weights light.
One-Arm Kettlebell Swings: Stand with feet a little wider than your hips, kettlebell on the floor in front of you, holding it with one hand.
Hinge at the hips, hike it back between your legs, then snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let it fall back and go straight into the next swing. Finish your reps, then switch hands.
Push Press: Hold a barbell on the front of your shoulders, hands just outside shoulder width.
Dip a few inches by bending your knees, then drive up through your legs and press the bar overhead in one motion.
Lock out overhead, then lower the bar back to your shoulders under control.
Side Bridge: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Hold for time, then switch sides.
Side Jackknife: Lie on your side with your legs stacked and your top hand behind your head.
Lift your top leg and upper body toward each other, crunching your side.
Lower slowly. Finish your reps, then switch sides.
